This file is a shrinking allowlist and is checked in BOTH directions:
- a violation that is not listed here fails the guard (a NEW defect);
- an entry listed here that no longer reproduces ALSO fails the guard,
so a fix cannot leave a stale excuse behind.
Removing an entry is the last step of fixing its finding. Nothing may be
added here without a finding ID.
